node.title: Calling a remote ssh connection from perl
node.author: KenHorse
node.doctext:
Using Linux and remote ssh command (I've placed my public ssh key on the remote server to allow non-password prompted connects) The following command runs fine from the Linux command line: ssh root@remoteIP /usr/bin/ls However, when the following is called from my perl script: system("ssh root@remoteIP /usr/bin/ls"); Perl reports: ssh: Could not resolve hostname root.remoteIP: Name or service not known remoteIP is the real IP address of the remote computer. Obviously, I need to tell Perl how to resolve the address?
